active_work_item.title: End-to-end real-quote regression and owner-acceptance handoff
active_work_item.depends_on: CP13-05 independently QA-passed at e9dc52af4cd701c7eae5b0d0eb53122d30252ed4 and squash-merged to main as 9a91bc14362c29d7260940ba6bf327bf69853085
active_work_item.reason: Engineering and Independent QA are complete for CP13-05. The sole remaining CP13 gate is explicit owner acceptance after personally testing at least two real quotes end to end.

commercial_milestone: Owner can personally select/upload 2-3 real quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis derived from those exact inputs without fabricated findings

save_game.verified_behavior: CP0-CP12 remain merged. CP13-01 provides genuine mobile-first Quote 1/2/3 file or pasted-text selection with replace/remove and Quote 1+2 gating. CP13-02 consumes exact pasted text/PDF bytes through real extraction adapters and stops image input at an explicit provider boundary when OCR is unavailable. CP13-03 sends exact selected sources/category through /api/analyze, source extraction, canonical evidence validation and grounded reasoning without demo substitution. CP13-04 binds the generated report to its server-scoped session and preserves same-session preview/unlock continuity without demo fallback. CP13-05 adds independently QA-passed deterministic end-to-end regression across genuine local text/PDF inputs through extraction, grounded analysis, generated report/session and same-session unlock, plus safe image-provider-required failure coverage and owner acceptance instructions.
save_game.risks: Owner acceptance remains incomplete. Image OCR remains provider-required without an authorized provider. Default runtime analysis remains deterministic. Transitional extracted_text_fixture naming remains technical debt. Production deployment/live payments/storage/providers/secrets/DNS/customer communication/ads remain RED.
save_game.rollback: Return to CP13-04 merged SHA 9031c8db05932bf73fe7d6d3f662ef1339c97ae4 if owner acceptance exposes a CP13-05 regression.

human_gate.required: Owner personally selects/uploads at least two real quotes, clicks Analyze, confirms the resulting grounded report is based on those exact inputs and remains the same analysis through preview/unlock, then explicitly records ACCEPT or REJECT.
